_comment: Example: two-arm trial with a BINARY primary endpoint (e.g. objective response rate), group-sequential with one interim, non-binding futility, no enrichment. Single hypothesis on the full population (prevalence=1 => H_S == H_F). Illustrative assumptions only.

report.title: Response-Rate Trial with Group-Sequential Monitoring
report.subtitle: Binary endpoint | one interim | non-binding futility
report.recommendation: Suitable for a randomized proof-of-concept where response rate is the primary readout; the interim futility look limits exposure if the treatment is inactive.
references: Jennison C, Turnbull BW. Group Sequential Methods with Applications to Clinical Trials. Chapman & Hall/CRC, 2000.
Wassmer G, Pahlke F. rpact: Confirmatory Adaptive Clinical Trial Design and Analysis. R package.
